title: 第1章 救她的是影帝！-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    2005年冬，海市影视城

    我去！

    冻死姑奶奶了！

    韩小汐明明记得自己只是走路走神，下一秒，怎么就到了冰冷的水里？！

    跳楼？小三？打工？上学？

    各种乱七八糟的记忆井喷式的砸进了脑海里。

    头痛，缺氧！

    她试着自救，抬起胳膊，胡乱地挣扎，似乎抱住了一只胳膊。

    死死地攥着，指甲抠进了肉里。

    终于后腰处有了支撑。

    韩小汐松了一口气，勉强睁开眼。

    老天奶——

    看到仙人了！

    上天堂了？

    下一秒，她整个人失去了意识。

    失去意识前，韩小汐想的还是——

    仙人挺面熟的，好像集团大老板！

    ……

    睁眼，闭眼，再睁眼。

    消毒水味太刺鼻，病房里空无一人。

    韩小汐索性拉过被子蒙上了头。

    还不如让她直接被车撞飞了！

    特么穿越到二十年前，是几个意思？！

    别人开局拿了白富美人设，她呢？！

    原身亲妈早逝多年，亲爹破产跳楼，留下个小三和拖油瓶弟弟。

    这还不是最惨的。

    原身今年大一，读的还是巨烧钱的美院！

    学费都凑不齐，逼得原身放寒假不回家，跑学校旁边的影视城当群演替身。

    这不，为了一场跳水替身戏，华丽丽的溺水，丢了小命！

    韩小汐对原主深表同情。

    正在她神游的时候，病房门外传来两声敲门声，随即门被打开。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Winter 2005, Haishi Film and Television City

I’m going!

Grandma is freezing to death!

Han Xiaoxi clearly remembered that she was just distracted while walking. How come she was in the cold water the next second?!

Jumping off a building?Mistress?work to earn a living?go to school?

All kinds of messy memories flooded into my mind.

Headache, lack of oxygen!

She tried to save herself, raised her arms, struggled wildly, and seemed to be holding one arm.

死死地攥着，指甲抠进了肉里。

Finally I have support in my lower back.

Han Xiaoxi breathed a sigh of relief and reluctantly opened his eyes.



I saw the immortal!

Go to heaven?

The next second, she completely lost consciousness.

Before losing consciousness, Han Xiaoxi was still thinking about——

The immortal looks very familiar, like the big boss of the group!

……

Open your eyes, close your eyes, open your eyes again.

The smell of disinfectant water is too pungent and there is no one in the ward.

Han Xiaoxi simply pulled the quilt over her head.

It’s better to let her be hit by a car!

What does it mean to travel back in time twenty years ago?!

Others started with the Bai Fumei character, what about her?!

My mother died many years ago, and my father went bankrupt and jumped off a building, leaving behind a mistress and a troubled younger brother.

This is not the worst thing.

I am a freshman this year, and I am studying at a very expensive academy of fine arts!

"I couldn't raise the tuition fees, so I was forced to stay away from home during the winter vacation and went to the film and television studio next to the school to work as a stand-in for extras.

No, for a diving stand-in scene, a gorgeous drowning, I lost my life!

​​ Han Xiaoxi deeply sympathizes with the original owner.

While she was wandering in her mind, there were two knocks on the door of the ward, and then the door was opened.
